𝗝𝗔𝗜𝗦𝗪𝗔𝗟 𝗕𝗥𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗦 𝗨𝗣 𝗙𝗜𝗙𝗧𝗬! 🇮🇳🔥

Yashasvi Jaiswal hit 50 (9 fours) in Wellington; India are 97/0 after 23 overs.
Still 271 behind NZ's 368.

Can India take the lead? 👇
